description: Paired 100-square waffles compare drinking-milk sales shares in 2010–11 and a selected year. Default: regular milk against a grey remainder, starting at the top left in both panels. All types is optional. Largest-remainder allocation; exact shares remain labelled. Two panels count as one waffle idiom.

transform.expr: milkFocus == 'All' ? datum.cell : datum.product == milkFocus ? datum.cell-datum.focus_start : datum.cell < datum.focus_start ? datum.cell+datum.focus_count : datum.cell
